decisions.situation: Status rule is ambiguous for a mission whose contract defines NO user-testing layer (boot_command=null by design, zero user-testing VCs): literal reading of no-boot would give gates_passed, contract-aware reading gives passed
decisions.action: chose validation_status=passed: the validation contract owns the definition of done, it assigns every assertion to scrutiny-review, and everything it defines ran and passed; gates_passed would falsely imply validation was cut short
